newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No more resignations, says Australia's Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No more resignations, says Australia's Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said there would be no further resignations over ministerial conflicts of interest.
"I certainly don't expect another resignation," Howard told reporters.
"But I've asked my colleagues to attend very carefully to their affairs and I believe they will and they have, and I await question time with great interest."
Then assistant treasurer Jim Short quit on Sunday after his office discovered that he had made a ministerial decision benefiting a bank in which he held shares.
On Tuesday, Brian Gibson resigned for similar reasons from his position as parliamentary secretary to the treasurer.
The opposition has asserted that other minister have similar conflicts on interest.
